auditFindings.finding: General approval helper does not validate supported vehicle type or per-document review/expiry. Actual packaged helper accepts APPROVED profile with rejected/expired license or unsupported vehicle. Financial context checks vehicleType as an entity identifier, not a car/motorcycle whitelist.
auditFindings.required: Server-owned, versioned operational review bound to actual vehicle and current document references; explicit expiry or administratively recorded not-applicable decision, no assumed validity.

auditFindings.finding: Approved driver can update vehicle/document/profile fields while preserving account approval; upload replaces document URL without invalidating individual review. Schema2 enforces document ownership; legacy profile update path does not apply that same ownership contract.
auditFindings.required: Protect review fields from driver writes; validate ownership consistently and invalidate matching approval on evidence changes; keep existing delivery completion possible.

auditFindings.finding: Candidate hydration checks profile status but region filtering uses live-state allowed-region arrays. Financial offer context does not read/fence profile work region or current region authorization. Starting/location permission also retains legacy Bronze/Silver/Gold broad fallback.
auditFindings.required: One explicit administrative region authorization and active-region/neighbor contract shared by start, candidate preparation and acceptance; fence region/version changes and remove undocumented tier bypass.

auditFindings.finding: Staff driver edit route cannot capture separate vehicle approval, document review or expiry. Bootstrap browser still uses direct status writes.
auditFindings.required: Audited staff API and understandable per-document review/expiry UI; scoped permissions, expected version and transactional audit; replace approval shortcut.

auditFindings.finding: General start-search approval guard does not itself reject explicit profile isActive=false; later candidate and financial acceptance guards already do.
auditFindings.required: Unify online-entry reason with actual operational eligibility rather than letting inactive profile appear online but receive no offers.
